question: Holmes says, “I observe from your forefinger that you make your own cigarettes. Have no hesitation in lighting one.” This remark shows that Holmes:
solution:
The correct answer is "**is a keen observer**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the **second paragraph** of the passage, it is mentioned that Mr. Holmes deduces that **Dr.Mortimer(stranger) is a smoker**.
 
• Mr. Holmes observes this fact by observing the** forefinger** of Dr. Mortimer closely.
 
• He deduces that Dr. Mortmer** makes his own cigarettes** and invites him to light one.

Hence, the correct answer is **option 1**.
